newsitem.title: USA: Service withdraws exchange offer for Loewen.
newsitem.headline: Service withdraws exchange offer for Loewen.

text.p: Service Corp International said Tuesday it had withdrawn its exchange offer for The Loewen Group Inc.

"(We have) decided not to pursue the acquisition of Loewen at this time," it said. "The cumulative effect of actions taken by Loewen since our offer was announced, and the disclosure of details related to certain of Loewen's other transactions, have adversely impacted (our) view of Loewen's value to (our) shareholders."
Service, a funeral and cemetery company, launched a hostile bid for Loewen in September. It later sweetened its offer to $2.9 billion.
In December, Loewen said it had signed or closed acquisitions totalling $325 million since Service made its hostile bid.
Service nevertheless reiterated its interest in Loewen.
"We continue to believe that a merger of (Service) and Loewen could be beneficial to the shareholders of both companies," it said.
